title: OL-20261120-1: Seed core/discover into every tenant and verify the first live run
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** connections workflow daily 05:17 UTC and on catalogue change
**Done check:** file:ledger/connections.json
**Status:** open

practical-solutions is wired; the seed kit and other tenants inherit core/discover by revendoring and adding the connections workflow. Overlaps CONNECT-1 (core PR 825, practical-solutions PR 171) filed by another session; unique parts there (Swanson closure, restatement detection, lexical no-credential embedding route) are to be re-filed against core/discover.
